mapper.select: SELECT id, username, display_name, password_hash, status, administrator, must_change_password, auth_version, failed_login_count, locked_until, last_login_at, version, deleted FROM sys_user WHERE LOWER(username) = LOWER(#{username}) AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT id, status, auth_version, must_change_password, deleted FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT DISTINCT r.code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted = FALSE AND r.deleted = FALSE AND r.status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY r.code

SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted = FALSE AND r.deleted = FALSE AND r.status = 'ENABLED' AND rp.deleted = FALSE AND p.deleted = FALSE AND p.status = 'ENABLED' AND p.code != 'system.administrator' ORDER BY p.code

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE id != #{id} AND administrator=TRUE AND deleted=FALSE AND status='ENABLED' AND (locked_until IS NULL OR locked_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND password_hash ~ '^\$2[aby]\$(0[4-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])\$[./A-Za-z0-9]{53}$'
SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE LOWER(username) = LOWER(#{username}) AND deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET failed_login_count = #{count}, locked_until = #{lockedUntil}, auth_version = auth_version + CASE WHEN #{incrementAuthVersion} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
UPDATE sys_user SET failed_login_count = 0, locked_until = NULL, last_login_at = #{loginAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE AND status = 'ENABLED'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sys_department WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE AND status = 'ENABLED' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET display_name=#{user.displayName}, department_id=#{user.departmentId}, email=#{user.email}, phone=#{user.phone}, version=version+1, auth_version=auth_version+1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by=#{user.updatedBy} WHERE id=#{user.id} AND version=#{user.version} AND deleted=FALSE

UPDATE sys_user SET password_hash=#{passwordHash}, password_changed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, must_change_password=#{mustChangePassword}, version=version+1, auth_version=auth_version+1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by=#{actor} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND deleted=FALSE
